htdemucs.name: HT-Demucs v4 (Hybrid Transformer)
htdemucs.description_es: Separación neuronal de stems en 4 pistas (Vocals, Drums, Bass, Other). Inferencia en VRAM pendiente; procesado actual vía DSP local.
htdemucs.description_en: 4-track neural stem separation (Vocals, Drums, Bass, Other). VRAM inference pending; current processing runs local DSP.

basicpitch.name: Spotify Basic Pitch (ONNX)
basicpitch.description_es: Transcripción polifónica audio-a-MIDI y seguimiento continuo de F0/pitch bend. Descarga compartida; inferencia neuronal pendiente.
basicpitch.description_en: Polyphonic audio-to-MIDI transcription and continuous F0/pitch-bend tracking. Shared weights; neural inference pending.

deepfilter.name: DeepFilterNet3 Studio Denoiser
deepfilter.description_es: Supresión neuronal de ruido estacionario de previo y sala a 48 kHz. Descarga compartida; inferencia neuronal pendiente.
deepfilter.description_en: 48 kHz neural stationary preamp and room noise suppression. Shared weights; neural inference pending.

whispertiny.name: Whisper Tiny Phoneme Aligner
whispertiny.description_es: Alineación temporal de fonemas vocales para corte automático de frases en AutoSlicer.
whispertiny.description_en: Vocal phoneme forced alignment for automatic phrase slicing in AutoSlicer.

rtneural_nam_base.name: RTNeural / NAM Grey-Box Base Weights
rtneural_nam_base.description_es: Pesos semilla WaveNet/LSTM para entrenamiento no lineal asistido en ABDAudioLab.
rtneural_nam_base.description_en: Seed WaveNet/LSTM weights for assisted nonlinear training in ABDAudioLab.
